title: Harness connection
text: Before any machine reports a harness, the module names each project's directory to open. With no project yet it shows the add-project cue instead, since there is no directory to name. Onboarding and machine detail share surface-specific relay installation observations. Family configuration never proves a desktop app or extension is installed; unsupported detection reads not observed. Hook trust and session activity remain configuration and readiness facts. Setup manages existing harness homes independently of installation; CLI readiness uses the shared PATH and bundled-executable resolver without a desktop inventory scan.
